{"summary": "The stage cluster has no critical or high findings in the digest. Kubescape shows NSA 70.0 and MITRE 75.0, with failures mainly about missing network policies, resource limits, and seccomp profiles on shop workloads. The only admin binding is cluster-admin to Group:/system:masters, which looks like a platform default. Node and control-plane checks were not done.", "targets": ["stage"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 14, "failed": 7, "skipped": 5, "score": 70}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 12, "failed": 5, "skipped": 5, "score": 75}, {"name": "Trivy PSS", "passed": 16, "failed": 1, "skipped": 0, "score": null}], "findings": [{"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "No network policies restricting ingress/egress", "resource": "shop/Deployment/cart, shop/Deployment/web (14 resources total)", "controls": ["C-0030"], "evidence": "Kubescape failed C-0030 "Ingress and Egress blocked" with resources: 14 (examples shop/Deployment/cart, shop/Deployment/web).", "fix": "Add a default-deny NetworkPolicy in the namespace, then allow needed traffic:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata: {name: default-deny, namespace: shop}
spec: {podSelector: {}, policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]}", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Pods missing seccomp profile", "resource": "3 workloads (PSS control 10)", "controls": ["Trivy PSS 10"], "evidence": "Trivy PSS control "10" Seccomp failed with fails: 3.", "fix": "Set in pod spec: securityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Missing memory limits/requests", "resource": "shop/Deployment/web (9 resources)", "controls": ["C-0004"], "evidence": "Kubescape failed C-0004 "Resources memory limit and request" with resources: 9 (example shop/Deployment/web).", "fix": "resources:
  requests: {memory: 128Mi}
  limits: {memory: 256Mi}", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Image tag ':latest' used", "resource": "shop/Deployment/cart, web, worker", "controls": ["KSV-0013"], "evidence": "Trivy KSV-0013 "Image tag ':latest' used" has count: 3 (cart, web, worker).", "fix": "Pin images to a specific version or digest, e.g. image: repo/app:1.2.3@sha256:<digest>", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Resource policies / CPU limits missing", "resource": "shop/Deployment/cart (14 resources)", "controls": ["C-0009", "KSV-0011"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0009 "Resource policies" has resources: 14, and Trivy KSV-0011 "CPU not limited" has count: 1 (shop/Deployment/cart).", "fix": "Add resources.limits.cpu, and a namespace LimitRange/ResourceQuota:
resources:
  limits: {cpu: 500m}", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding cluster-admin", "controls": ["rbac_and_argo"], "evidence": "Binding "cluster-admin" grants role cluster-admin to subjects ["Group:/system:masters"]; this looks like the platform default, so I judged it expected.", "fix": "No change if default. Keep system:masters membership restricted and use scoped RBAC for people and automation.", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Medium vulnerabilities and minor misconfigurations", "resource": "stage cluster images", "controls": ["Trivy vuln", "Trivy misconfig"], "evidence": "Trivy vuln_counts shows MEDIUM: 6 with critical_high_vulns empty, and misconfig_counts shows LOW: 14.", "fix": "Rebuild the images on updated base images and re-scan. The digest gives no fixed versions.", "confidence": "medium"}], "not_checked": [{"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "repos", "reason": "The digest has no repos to assess."}]}
